SPEC IDEA · NOT A CLIENT PROJECT

The Ingredient Receipt

Brief I set myself: make a clean-label snack brand feel trustworthy to a 24-year-old who reads every label.
The ideaA QR on every pack
It opens a receipt-style page: where each ingredient came from, what it cost, and one thing the brand hasn't solved yet.
Why it worksHonesty reads as proof
Admitting a gap costs the brand something, so people believe the rest. Creators post the receipt as a story; customers screenshot the line they care about.
I'd measure
QR scans per pack · story shares per creator · repeat purchase in 60 days

Before you ask

01When can you start?

I graduate from ISB with the class of 2027 and can join right after. Until then, I'd love to take on a live project or a short sprint with your team, so you can see how I work before day one.

02What roles are you looking for?

Brand, growth, digital marketing and general management roles, on teams where an idea has to earn its place with numbers. I'm at my best where content, community and commercial results meet, because that's where I've spent the last eight years.

03What do you bring that others don't?

I've sat on every side of the brief. At KPMG I read businesses the way investors do. As a creator I've been the person brands brief, close to 50 times. As a founder I turned attention into ₹10L+ of sales. At Wireworks I made a quiet B2B page a hiring channel. So briefs, budgets and results connect from the first meeting.

04How do you measure success?

With one number the business truly cares about, agreed upfront: orders, hires, sign-ups or repeat purchase. Reach, saves and shares tell me what's working along the way. I review every month and move effort to whatever drives the main number.

05What are you excited to learn next?

Running paid media at real scale. Everything I've grown so far has been organic, which taught me what makes people genuinely care. I've made a start with the Google Ads Search and HubSpot Content Marketing certifications, and I'm excited to pair that instinct with real ad budgets and see how much further it goes.

06How do you like to work with a team?

A clear brief, a number to hit and early, honest feedback. I share drafts fast, bring the data along with the idea, and pull in sales, design and leadership early so launches never stall at the last step.

About Tanisha Saxena, in plain words

Tanisha Saxena is a marketer studying in the PGP at the Indian School of Business (class of 2026–27) and a graduate of Lady Shri Ram College for Women, Delhi University. She is looking for brand, growth, digital marketing and general management roles.

She spent four years at KPMG India on investor relations and consulting work, including investor perception studies, peer benchmarking and an alternate-channel growth plan that delivered 5% year-on-year revenue growth for a ₹462 crore footwear brand. Since 2018 she has run @tanisha_saxena07, a sustainable fashion and lifestyle creator account, with close to 50 brand collaborations and ₹7 lakh+ in affiliate revenue for The Whole Truth; she was one of 10 creators picked for Taneira's campaign with Goonj.

She co-founded Azure Finds, an Instagram pre-loved fashion store that reached ₹10 lakh+ in sales across 2,000+ orders. From July 2025 to April 2026 she ran social media for Wireworks, growing its LinkedIn page organically to 8,000+ followers and making it the source of about one in five hires.
